title: Egg-shaped tall white craft using Dog Bone Lake as a landing field
place_text: North end of Indian Springs Valley / Dog Bone Lake, Nevada

tellings.quote: their base at the north end of Indian uh at Indian Springs, they were using Dog Bone Lake as their landing field.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he served at Air Force ranges in Nevada in the mid 1960s, says he spent about three years around tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that these beings had a base at the north end of Indian Springs Valley and flew egg-shaped craft that used a dry lakebed called Dog Bone Lake as their landing field. If true, it would mean beings from elsewhere were keeping a base on US military land.
